name: Benchmark Score Validation
summary: Validate that a benchmark score is within the expected range for the given GPU model and that all metadata is present and correct
purpose: Validate that a benchmark score is within the expected range for the given GPU model and that all metadata is present and correct.
assignment_instructions: You are validating a compute benchmark score. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "compute_benchmark_score_validation_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - benchmark_name (string): name of the benchmark - gpu_model (string): GPU model used - score (number): the benchmark score - score_units (string): units of the score (e.g., "samples/sec", "TFLOPS", "ms") - expected_range_min (number or null): known minimum for this GPU+benchmark - expected_range_max (number or null): known maximum for this GPU+benchmark - score_within_expected_range (boolean or null): expected_range_min <= score <= expected_range_max - score_not_null (boolean): score is not null and is numeric - units_correct (boolean): score_units is a recognized unit for this benchmark - score_percentile (number or null): where score falls within expected range as (score - min) / (max - min), null if range unknown Compute score_percentile as (score - expected_range_min) / (expected_range_max - expected_range_min) when both bounds are known. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
